== Summary ==
The Players Committee's errata wording of [[Rogue Asteroid]] (both sides; “defense value = 3”) as printed in Appendix A. Image for [[Rogue Asteroid (PC Errata)]].

Source: Players Committee, SWCCG 2023 Advanced Rulebook, Appendix A ([[Media:SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf|wiki copy]]; [https://res.starwarsccg.org/rules/SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf res.starwarsccg.org]), PDF page 126; rendered at 300 dpi and cropped to the entry.
